verdict.rationale: Rippling's own pages describe a built-in assistant. Users can 'Ask Rippling' about devices, threats or compliance gaps, and the AI automates remediations and builds reports. Users can also 'tell Rippling what you need' and agents handle device ordering, routing, retrieval and retirement, which is task delegation inside the product. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the assistant's actions, approval controls and limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond marketing claims.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Ask Rippling about any device, threat, or compliance gap—and AI surfaces answers, automates remediations, and builds audit-ready reports.
Tell Rippling what you need and agents handle ordering, routing, retrieving, and retiring devices across every warehouse and employee worldwide.
Ask Rippling AI anything across all your data
